source.author: Kamal Choudhary
source.changes: Selected every matching record for the 22 named formulas; added locators and display metadata. Source object strings are unchanged.

scope.conditions: Individual calculation temperature, pressure and convergence are not established by this metadata view.
scope.association: Provider JID only; no association with catalogue measurements or COD reference geometries.
scope.ehull: Excluded from axes: captured same-formula differences require normalization review. Original values remain in the source download.
scope.inference: Formation energy relative to elemental references is not convex-hull, phonon, chemical or finite-temperature stability. The band gap is an electronic descriptor, not a pairing or superconducting gap.
